## POOL OF POSSIBILITIES; ACHIEVEMENT FOR LIFE _Providing opportunities for our members to pursue their goals_ Pacific Swimming, the third largest of USA Swimming's 57 regional associations, is made up of 100 swim clubs and more than 14,000 swimmers. While our membership is centered in California's San Francisco Bay Area, our territory also includes the coastal counties of Northern California from Monterey to the Oregon border, the Stockton-Modesto area of California's Central Valley, and the Reno-Carson City-Lake Tahoe area on the California-Nevada border. - **[October 9, 2026 - Last Call for Signups for 2026 Officials Clinic, Athlete Summit and Award Banquet](https://www.pacswim.org/news/last-call-for-signups-for-2026-officials-clinic-athlete-summit-and-award-banquet/detail)** This is the last call for signups for all of our events happening next weekend - October 17th-18th. Accurate counts will help us manage the correct food and staffing. For more information or to sign up for any of the events, click on the links below. - **[October 7, 2026 - Fall 2026 Disability Diversity Equity & Inclusion Grant Applications Now Available](https://www.pacswim.org/news/fall-2026-disability-diversity-equity-inclusion-grant-applications-now-available/detail)** The newest Disability Diversity Equity & Inclusion Grant Application for Fall 2026 is now available. It is due by Friday, October 30th. Click to read more information about the Disability Diversity Equity & Inclusion Grant Program and how to apply for a Grant. - **[October 5, 2026 - Stroke & Turn Officials Applications to Officiate - November 6-8, 2026, Senior 2 Prelim & Finals Meet](https://www.pacswim.org/news/stroke-turn-officials-applications-to-officiate-november-6-8-2026-senior-2-prelim-finals-meet/detail)** Certified Stroke and Turn Officials are invited to officiate at the November 6-8, 2026, Pleasanton Seahawks, Senior 2 Prelim & Finals Meet. This meet is also designated as an Official Qualifying Meet (OQM). Officials that have met the minimum requirements for a national evaluation may request advancement or recertification. Click for more details and the link to apply. - **[October 1, 2026 - Team Assignments for 2027 Adam Szmidt Memorial LC AG & Senior Champs, July 9-11, 2027](https://www.pacswim.org/news/team-assignments-for-2027-adam-szmidt-memorial-lc-ag-senior-champs-july-9-11-2027/detail)** Team assignments for the 2027 Adam Szmidt Memorial LC AG & Senior Champs, July 9-11, 2027, have been assigned. Click for more details and a link to the list. - **[September 29, 2026 - 2027 Pacific Coast All-Star Coaching Applications Now Available](https://www.pacswim.org/news/2027-pacific-coast-all-star-coaching-applications-now-available/detail)** The Coach applications are now available for the 2027 Pacific Coast All-Star Meet, to be held in Snohomish, WA, January 9-10, 2027. Athlete applications coming soon. Click for more details. - **[September 28, 2026 - Competition Updates - September 2026](https://www.pacswim.org/news/competition-updates-september-2026/detail)** Please see attached document from the Competition Coordinator, Beau Caldwell, on upcoming competition information from the Age Group and Senior Committees. Click for more details. - **[September 28, 2026 - 2026 PacSwim Awards: Coach of the Year Finalists](https://www.pacswim.org/news/2026-pacswim-awards-coach-of-the-year-finalists/detail)** The following coaches have been nominated as finalists for the 2025-26 Coach of the Year awards at the annual PacSwim Awards. Winners will be determined by coaches only voting. Coaches look for your email with the link to vote between these finalists to determine the winners. Award winners will be notified prior to the awards banquet on October 17th. Congratulations to everyone nominated! - **[September 26, 2026 - 2026 PacSwim Awards: Swimmer of the Year Finalists](https://www.pacswim.org/news/2026-pacswim-awards-swimmer-of-the-year-finalists/detail)** The following swimmers have been selected as finalists for PC's Swimmer of the Year awards. The winners will be announced at the PacSwim Awards on October 17, 2026. - **[September 25, 2026 - 2026 PacSwim Awards: Outstanding Swimmer Finalists (Long Course)](https://www.pacswim.org/news/2026-pacswim-awards-outstanding-swimmer-finalists-long-course/detail)** Congratulations to the swimmers who have been selected as finalists for Pacific Swimming's Long Course Outstanding Swimmers for their age for the 2025-26 season. These finalists will be invited to the annual PacSwim Awards, October 17, 2026, where the winners will be announced. Click for more details. - **[September 25, 2026 - 2026 PacSwim Awards: Outstanding Swimmer Finalists (Short Course)](https://www.pacswim.org/news/2026-pacswim-awards-outstanding-swimmer-finalists-short-course/detail)** Congratulations to the swimmers who have been selected as finalists for Pacific Swimming's Short Course Outstanding Swimmers for their age for the 2025-26 season. These finalists will be invited to the annual PacSwim Awards, October 17, 2026, where the winners will be announced. Click for more details. - **[September 20, 2026 - Registration is Now Open for the LSC-Wide Officials Clinic, Saturday, October 17, 2026](https://www.pacswim.org/news/registration-is-now-open-for-the-lsc-wide-officials-clinic-saturday-october-17-2026/detail)** New and Current Officials of all levels, please plan to join us for our LSC-wide Officials Clinic, held Saturday, October 17, 2026, from 8:00 am until 4:00 pm at the Pleasant Hill Senior Center at 233 Gregory Lane in Pleasant Hill, CA. As the 2026-27 swim season commences, we know there is an immediate need for new Stroke and Turn Officials, as well as a need for Refresher Training for our Current Officials. Click for more information. - **[September 18, 2026 - Golden State Warriors Swim Night Coming in January](https://www.pacswim.org/news/golden-state-warriors-swim-night-coming-in-january/detail)** The Golden State Warriors have just officially announced Swim Night as January 2, 2027, vs. the Brooklyn Nets! If you would like to join the Warriors, look into securing your spot as soon as possible before inventory runs low. Tickets include a free Golden State Warriors swim cap. Click for more details. - **[September 16, 2026 - New Swimmer Registration Help](https://www.pacswim.org/news/new-swimmer-registration-help/detail)** Many families are having issues with registering their new swimmers to USA Swimming. The most common issue is parents creating parent accounts under their swimmer's name and then believing they have registered their child. Parents need to create their parent account with their name first. Please speak with your team to get help with registering your swimmer. Click for more details and a link for more help. - **[September 8, 2026 - Congratulations to our Safe Sport Recognized Clubs TERA, SUNN, PSL, PLS, ALGA, SRN, PST, PPSC, MAC, TCA, DCD, TIDE, SFSL, CCSC, SBA, EBSD, ALTO, OAPB, LAC, FOG, VJO, PASA, WCAB, NVST, SON, SRBY, AAA, BSW, MBSC, SCSC, CDST, HILL, DDST, SSS, BAY, BAC & MONT](https://www.pacswim.org/news/congratulations-to-our-safe-sport-recognized-clubs-tera-sunn-psl-pls-alga-srn-pst-ppsc-mac-tca-dcd-tide-sfsl-ccsc-sba-ebsd-alto-oapb-lac-fog-vjo-pasa-wcab-nvst-son-srby-aaa-bsw-mbsc-scsc-cdst-hill-ddst-sss-bay-bac-mont/detail)** We would like to recognize Terrapins Swim Team, SUNN Swimming, Pacifica Sea Lions, Pleasanton Seahawks, Alameda Gators, Neptune Swimming, Piedmont Swim Team, Pacifica Platypus Swim Club, Milpitas Aquatic Club, Thunder Coast Aquatics, Daly City Dophins, Almaden Riptide, San Francisco Seals Swim Team, Crescent City Swim Club, San Benito Aquatics, East Bay Silver Dolphins, Alto Swim Club, Orinda Aquatics, Livermore Aquacowboys, Fog City Hammerheads, Vallejo Aquatic Club, Palo Alto Stanford Aquatics, Walnut Creek Aquabears, Napa Valley Swim Team, Sonoma Sea Dragons, Seals Aquatics, Albany Armada Aquatics, Brentwood Seawolves, Monterey Bay Swim Club, Santa Clara Swim Club, California Dolphins Swim Team, Hills Hurricane Swimming, Douglas Dolphins Swim Team, Sebastopol Sea Serpents, Swim South Bay, Burlingame Aquatic Club, and Montclair Swim Team, on achieving Safe Sport Recognized Club status! The Safe Sport Recognized Club Program (“SSRP”) allows a USA Swimming member club to publicly demonstrate its unwavering commitment to creating an abuse-free, safe, healthy and positive environment for all its members through the implementation of the Minor Athlete Abuse Prevention Policy, Anti-Bullying measures, Safe Sport Best Practices and Athlete Protection Training. Click for more details on how your club can become a Safe Sport Recognized Club. - **[August 13, 2026 - USA Swimming's Women in Leadership Clinic - November 20-22, 2026](https://www.pacswim.org/news/usa-swimming-s-women-in-leadership-clinic-november-20-22-2026/detail)** The Women's Leadership Clinic focuses on leadership development, by striving to support female coaches with varying levels of experience build their comfort and expertise in leadership skills on and off the deck. The clinic provides immersive educational sessions and interactive connection opportunities with fellow members of the USA Swimming community. Click for more details and the link to sign up. As we move into short course championship season, it can be interesting to view the Virtual Club Championship standings.  These are automatically generated by the times entered into the SWIMS database.  More information about the Virtual Club Championship can be found here: http://www.usaswimming.org/DesktopDefault.aspx?TabId=1617&Alias=Rainbow&Lang=en-US

Getting detailed club information can be generated from this page: [https://www.usaswimming.org/topic-page/recognition-incentive-programs/virtual-club-championship-(vcc)?target=//www.usaswimming.org/resources-home/resource-topic](https://www.usaswimming.org/topic-page/recognition-incentive-programs/virtual-club-championship-(vcc)?target=//www.usaswimming.org/resources-home/resource-topic)


### Club Excellence Program


This program rewards clubs that have elite 18 and under swimmers.  Each club earns points based on the FINA Points Table.  The top 20 clubs in the nation are designated Gold Level Ranking. Clubs ranking between 21-100 are Silver Level Ranking and clubs ranking between 101-200 are Bronze Level Ranking.  Only the top 200 clubs in the nation get a ranking.  The rankings are recalculated every year and clubs can move up and down based on the current swimmers’ times. More information on this program can be found here: [https://www.usaswimming.org/coaches-leaders/connect-learn/programs-services#club-excellence](https://www.usaswimming.org/coaches-leaders/connect-learn/programs-services#club-excellence)
